{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now count patients with severe baseline disease
total_patients = len(df_dedup)
severe_patients = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()

# Compute fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients

print(f'Total deduplicated patients: {total_patients}')
print(f'Severe baseline patients: {severe_patients}')
print(f'Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}')"}
